cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Cowork ciden surface labɛn : a sandboxed shell, ka fara hakilijiginw ni sekow kan minnu maralen bɛ kudayi i ka Novera kunnafonidilan kɔnɔ.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Cikanw bɛ boli ka da {{backend}} fɛ: u bɛ se ka sɛbɛnni kɛ session baarakɛyɔrɔ kɔnɔ dɔrɔn, wa dosiye minnu bɛ i ka so foli kɔnɔ, olu tɛ kalan.

cowork.network: Ka sira di Rezow sɔrɔli ma
cowork.networkDesc: A to Cowork cikanw ka se ɛntɛrinɛti kan, fɛnw kama i n’a fɔ pakew sigili walima fɛnmarayɔrɔ dɔ tali. On ka kɛɲɛ ni default ye. Chat kunba ka shell tɛ sɔrɔ abada rezow la.
cowork.noMemories: Hakilijigin si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Modeliw b’u fara u kan ni memory_write baarakɛminɛn ye n’u bɛ fɛnw dege minnu nafa ka bon ka mara.
cowork.noSkills: Seko si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Seko ni dɔnko ye cikanw ye minnu bɛ se ka baara kokura, modɛli bɛ se ka minnu doni ni ɲinini kɛra.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Barokun kelen sɛbɛn kelen kɔnɔ. Modeliw bɛ ninnu kalan ka segin ni memory_read baarakɛminɛn ye.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown cikanw, ni a bɛ se ka kɛ ni ɲɛfɔli ye YAML ɲɛfɛ. Ɲɛfɔli ye min ye modeliw bɛ min ye sani u ka seko doni.

cowork.revealFailed: A ma se ka foli da wuli

privacy.promise1: Aw ka barow bɛ to aw yɛrɛ la ani aw ka minɛn kɔnɔ
privacy.promise2: An tɛ i ka kunnafoniw walima i ka baro kɔnɔkow lajɛ abada
privacy.promise3: Donanw tilatilali bɛɛ ye tɔgɔko ye, wa a bɛ lajɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ
